skill.name: seedance-prompt
skill.description: Generates structured Seedance 2.0 prompts for 15-second product motion graphics videos. It guides product details, reference images, visual style selection, timing, sound design, and optional Dreamina CLI use.
skill.summary: Create Seedance 2.0 product video prompts with timed motion, visual style, audio direction, and reference image guidance.
skill.author: op7418

security_audit.summary: The core prompt-generation instructions are mostly benign, and several static hits are Markdown or aesthetic false positives. The material security issue is the repeated curl-to-bash Dreamina CLI installation guidance, plus a privacy concern around sending prompts and image assets to a third-party CLI.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-bash instructions with a verified package manager install, checksum verification, or a link to official manual installation steps.

remediation.issue: Third-party CLI use may transmit prompts and image assets.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step that explains what data Dreamina receives before invoking the CLI with prompts or image paths.

remediation.issue: CLI availability checks are run as part of the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Ask permission before running local commands, and keep checks limited to hardcoded commands such as which dreamina or dreamina --version.

content.value_statement: Product teams need clear video prompts that translate features into polished motion design. This skill structures Seedance 2.0 prompts with timing, style, transitions, audio, and reference image guidance.
actual_capabilities: Collects product goals, target features, reference images, and voiceover needs before drafting.
Selects one of four visual styles for product motion graphics.
Creates a 15-second one-take Seedance prompt with timed morphing stages.
Adds sound design, music direction, and optional inline voiceover cues.
Labels reference image placeholders for Seedance all-purpose reference mode.
Can guide optional Dreamina CLI generation after prompt creation.
limitations: It creates prompts and guidance; it does not guarantee final video quality.
Dreamina CLI use depends on the user's local installation and account access.
Reference image accuracy depends on the images supplied by the user.
The skill is focused on short product promotion videos, not long-form scripts.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Animation
use_cases.description: Create a concise Seedance prompt for a new product reveal with brand style, logo timing, and audio direction.

use_cases.title: Feature Demo Concept
use_cases.description: Turn a feature list into abstract motion stages that show value through smooth visual transformations.

use_cases.title: Reference Image Prompting
use_cases.description: Prepare image placeholders and usage notes for logos, screenshots, or product visuals in Seedance reference mode.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Product Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with product name and goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Seedance 2.0 product video prompt for my product. Ask me for the product name, main value, target audience, and desired mood first.

prompt_templates.title: Style-Guided Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a specific visual direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second Seedance prompt for my product using the Vercel or Linear dark style. Include timed stages, transitions, sound design, and music.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Image Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: User has logo or interface images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my logo and product screenshots as references. Mark each image placeholder, explain where it appears in the timeline, and create the final Seedance prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Launch Video
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs a complete launch-ready concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a polished Seedance product launch prompt with six timed stages, five distinct morph transitions, inline voiceover cues, music, sound design, and reference image notes.

output_examples.input: A productivity app needs a clean 15-second launch animation with a calm premium style.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a Seedance prompt using a premium glass style, six timed visual stages, a logo reveal, soft sound design, and restrained music direction.

output_examples.input: A developer tool has a logo image and wants a high-energy dark motion graphic.
output_examples.output: The skill labels the logo reference image, selects the dark technical style, maps features into grid and wireframe motions, and adds Dreamina usage guidance.

output_examples.input: A product marketer wants voiceover included during the video timeline.
output_examples.output: The skill embeds short voiceover lines inside the timed stages and keeps the final prompt within the Seedance character limit.

best_practices: Provide the product name, audience, core value, and brand mood before requesting the final prompt.
Share logo or interface images when visual accuracy matters.
Review third-party CLI steps before allowing any local command execution.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic video without product details or a visual goal.
Do not include sensitive unreleased assets unless third-party video processing is acceptable.
Do not run remote installation commands without verifying the source and install method.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates English Seedance 2.0 prompts for short product motion graphics videos.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can label logo, screenshot, or product image placeholders for Seedance reference mode.

faq.question: Does it generate the video itself?
faq.answer: No. It writes the prompt and can guide optional Dreamina CLI use when available.

faq.question: Which styles are supported?
faq.answer: It supports Apple-style premium glass, Microsoft Fluent, Bauhaus minimalism, and Vercel or Linear dark styles.

faq.question: Can it include voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. It can place short voiceover lines inside specific timeline stages.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide product positioning, key features, audience, brand mood, and any logo or interface images.
